nodes.label: Deployment Branch Model (main->preview->deploy)
nodes.rationale: Three branches: main (full repo), preview (curated app-file subset, staging domain), deploy (production copy of preview). Never git push directly to preview/deploy — they are managed only via the promotion steps. 'deploy' intentionally bypasses preview because triggering a preview build is pointless when shipping straight to production; package.json is deliberately excluded from promotion (preview/deploy keep their own minimal one).

nodes.label: Dev-only GPS Sim Deploy Toggle
nodes.rationale: Step 0 of every deploy comments out initGpsSim() in src/app.js (committed to main and promoted), and Step 9 restores it in the working tree only (never staged/committed), so the simulator is available locally yet never ships enabled on main, preview, or deploy.
